mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium) may potentiate cholinergic effects of rivastigmine, increasing risk of syncope, bradycardia, and adverse vagomimetic effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes regularly, particularly potassium and magnesium levels; assess blood pressure and heart rate; consider potassium supplementation or potassium-sparing diuretic co-therapy if clinically appropriate.
